guide.tears-of-ink.mirror_vestibule: Not now, little one. The gate is right in front of you.
letter.tears-of-ink.invitation:
Dear guest!

You are invited to the Ink Lands — a land of fog, blood and ink, where every hope has its price.

Sign, and the dim mirror will open the way. There will be no way back… almost.

With deepest respect,
Mister Guide
diary.tears-of-ink.title: The Historian's Diary
diary.tears-of-ink.empty: The pages are empty. For now.
guide.tears-of-ink.greet.1: Honored Guest! Welcome to the Vestibule — I do hope your journey was not too tiring.
guide.tears-of-ink.greet.2: The gates behind me lead to the Ink Lands. Many arrived there before you… But they did not succeed. Perhaps you will be the one to change everything?
guide.tears-of-ink.greet.3: This enchanted mirror will let you travel between worlds. Do not worry: I have made sure it will always remain with you.
guide.tears-of-ink.greet.4: Please, accept this modest gift. A shame its previous owner never had a chance to use it…
guide.tears-of-ink.greet.5: I wish you a pleasant stay. Enjoy this adventure… And do not disappoint me…
message.tears-of-ink.diary_new: A new entry seeps through the diary's pages…
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.first_steps.tex:
So you have arrived in the Ink Lands. Your vow is sworn and cannot be changed. Touch the bowl in the starting temple with an empty hand. In Fate I shall mark your journey; you can hide the objectives on your screen. Remember the key from your gift: right-click it to call you toward another temple.
Search the chests and look for pale ore: metal, Asphoda and Ink are needed for your first forge. Stay near the roads and light. I shall try to remember what might help you.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.pale_metal.text:
Look for pale ore in the Pale Forest. Raw metal may be found in chests at the starting temple, ruins and military sites, and among the spoils of pale soldiers. Smelt it in a furnace or blast furnace.
If you have a worn shield, restore it with one Pale Ingot at a crafting table: [[restore_ram_shield|Ram Shield]] or [[restore_mercy_shield|Shield of Mercy]]. Restore the Dim Scimitar with one ingot too: [[restore_dim_scimitar|Wave Sword]].
The next important crafting milestone is the [[ink_anvil|Ink Anvil]]. Find Asphoda underground or in chests, where you may also find Ink. Make it at a regular crafting table. Now you have a forge of your own.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.fountain_hunt.t:
The first drink from each new bowl grants +5 maximum Ink, up to 200. Touch an opened bowl again to bind your respawn; at the cap a new bowl still binds you without spending its future bonus.
Your vow's key is an Ink Tear or Shard of Hope. Right-click it for a short trail of sparks toward another temple. The trail fades after two personal fountain activations. Hear out the Trader at the second bowl, then summon her with Shift-right-click on any bowl you have opened. She pays 3 Pigment per fulfilled contract. Do not rely on temple chests for Pigment.
Build the Ascension Font yourself. Its 5×5 footprint needs nine scarlet wood blocks under the central 3×3 water area and a ring of sixteen pale wood blocks at water level. Above each of the four corners of the ring, place two scarlet wood blocks. Stand in the center of the water; the Font will highlight missing pieces.
Hold a weapon and Shift-right-click. Dim to Contrast: 8 Pigment and one rare resource of its line. Contrast to Rubric: 16 Pigment and two resources. Spire needs Sigils of Valor (contracts), Blood needs Crimson Flowers (Harvest), and Ink needs Motes of Hope (special Trader orders).
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.intro.title: Whoever You May Be
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.intro.text: If you are reading this, then you have already met the Guide. Mister Guide, as he calls himself. There is more to that being than meets the eye — an ancient creature capable of traveling between worlds… But that is not what matters now. I once recorded the history of this world, yet since I was imprisoned in this book, my memories have become terribly distorted. Help me remember, and I will share whatever comes back to me. Trust no one — nothing here is quite what it seems… Sanguine nati, atramento mergentur.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.caterpillar.tex: Tiny creatures that inhabit the Ink Lands. Harmless. Several varieties exist, each dwelling in its own region.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.caterpillar_pal: The Pale Forest caterpillar is a small creature that feeds on Tearbloom. Its size and gentle nature make it easy prey for predators and monsters.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.caterpillar_blo: The Bloodwood caterpillar is plump and fleshy. Saturated with the Blood Herald's blood, it carries a glimmer of hope for those who have not yet succumbed to the Curse of Ink. These caterpillars are harmless, and their bodies provide food for the locals. They feed on blood from Blood Collectors and on fleshberries. When maximum Soul falls to 70 or below, their raw meat becomes especially nourishing.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.caterpillar_ink: Inkwood caterpillars are nimble little creatures that leave an oily trail of Ink behind them. Ink is more concentrated in the Inkwood, and it shows in the local wildlife. These tiny beings carry a rare resource — Pigment — that is highly valued in these lands.
diary.tears-of-ink.illegible: (the script grows illegible, dissolving into a meaningless jumble of symbols)
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.pale_spearman.t: A limited consciousness, imprisoned in a vicious cage… This pale soldier has long since lost everything a person should possess: remorse, anger, joy, love… Only a cold shell filled with strength remains. Yet even the Curse of Ink coursing through his withered veins could not break the iron discipline beaten into him through brutal drills. The spearman is dangerous. Spearmen keep their distance, strike from the flanks, support their squad, and prevent enemies from reaching the crossbowmen. Beware: when the shieldbearer dies, the spearman charges. He will not retreat again.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.pale_shieldbear: A limited consciousness, imprisoned in a vicious cage… This pale soldier has long since lost everything a person should possess: remorse, anger, joy, love… Only a cold shell filled with strength remains. Yet even the Curse of Ink coursing through his withered veins could not break the iron discipline beaten into him through brutal drills. The shieldbearer is the backbone of the squad. He keeps enemies under pressure and crushes them with sheer muscle and misshapen flesh. His strength can shatter unstable ground and sweep aside entire groups. Despite his slowness, he reacts instantly when his fellow crossbowmen are attacked. Strike when he crashes into an obstacle after a charge.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.pale_crossbowma: A limited consciousness, imprisoned in a vicious cage… This pale soldier has long since lost everything a person should possess: remorse, anger, joy, love… Only a cold shell filled with strength remains. Yet even the Curse of Ink coursing through his withered veins could not break the iron discipline beaten into him through brutal drills. The nimble, cunning crossbowman rains bolts upon his foes. Ink has sharpened his senses, and now he strikes anyone who dares step out of cover. Approach him too closely and he will leap away and call for help. It is often best to deal with the crossbowmen first — but expect fierce resistance.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.zombie.title: Zombie
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.zombie.text: The irresistible power of the Curse of Ink could find no place within this frail body: it was unfit to serve as a Vessel. Unfortunately for the deceased, it can still raise him and send him stumbling onward — perhaps in the hope that a swift thrust will someday pierce his worm-eaten Ink heart.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.skeleton.title: Skeleton
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.skeleton.text: The remains of a skilled archer, raised from the earth by the Curse of Ink. In life, he was likely a fine marksman — death has done little to dull his skill.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.spider.title: Spider
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.spider.text: Dark spawn of the Ink Lands, lurking in the shadows even beneath the motionless Crimson Sun. Hunger and a thirst for blood drive them — beware of ambushes in the dark. Their red eyes are always upon you. The important thing is not to turn your back on the darkness at the wrong moment…

item.tears-of-ink.fulfilled_contract.des: Give it to the Soul Trader at an ink fountain.
trader.tears-of-ink.title: Soul Trader
trader.tears-of-ink.greet: The Ink stirs, and a silhouette emerges… “You called — and here I am. As always.”
trader.tears-of-ink.need_second_fountain: The Trader will appear at your second activated fountain.
trader.tears-of-ink.intro.1: Don't be frightened, little one. I am the Soul Trader. Should you need my services, call for me at a fountain.
trader.tears-of-ink.intro.2: Hunters roam these lands. If you wish to test yourself, I can arrange for you to join one on a Hunt.
trader.tears-of-ink.intro.3: I pay in Pigment for fulfilled contracts. There are special orders, too — for Hunters who have lost their minds.
trader.tears-of-ink.intro.4: Ink can grant you great power. But remember, little one: sometimes that power costs you a piece of your own Soul.
trader.tears-of-ink.intro.complete: You can now speak to the Trader.
trader.tears-of-ink.need_drink: The fountain is silent. Drink from it first.
trader.tears-of-ink.no_room: There is not enough room by the fountain for the Ink to take shape.
trader.tears-of-ink.page: The fountain remembers everyone who drank from it. So do I. How may I serve you?
trader.tears-of-ink.option.sell: Sell a fragment of your Soul
trader.tears-of-ink.sell.text: I will take a fragment of your Soul and fill your veins with Ink. Think carefully about what you will lose:
trader.tears-of-ink.sell.none: There is nothing left for me to take.
trader.tears-of-ink.sold: The bargain is struck. Soul: %s. Ink capacity: %s.
trader.tears-of-ink.nothing_left: There is nothing left for me to take.
trader.tears-of-ink.farewell: “The fountain remembers. And so shall I.”

hunt.tears-of-ink.devoured: The prey has torn the hunter apart! Whoever finishes it gets a double reward.

hunt.tears-of-ink.won_double: The prey that devoured the hunter has fallen. Double contracts go to: %s.
hunt.tears-of-ink.your_reward: Hunt: you received a Fulfilled Contract (%s) and loot.
hunt.tears-of-ink.remote_hunter: Somewhere in the fog, %s caught the prey.
hunt.tears-of-ink.remote_prey: Somewhere in the fog, the prey tore apart the hunter (%s).
hunt.tears-of-ink.frenzy: %s turns the blade on the living!
trader.tears-of-ink.contract_weapon: This hunter left something for you: %s.
hunt.tears-of-ink.half_down: One half of the prey has fallen — one remains.
trader.tears-of-ink.board.reward.2: Reward: Pigment and the hunter weapon

trader.tears-of-ink.board.busy: Finish what you started. One contract at a time.
trader.tears-of-ink.board.no_place: The fog hides every path. Try later.
trader.tears-of-ink.board.abandoned: The contract is torn. The Fountain will remember.
hunt.tears-of-ink.contract_timeout: The contract burned out: time is up.
hunt.tears-of-ink.contract_found: You are there. %s is here — the Hunt begins!
hunt.tears-of-ink.contract_lost: %s got there first. The contract is lost.
trader.tears-of-ink.board.accepted: Agreed. %1$s is yours. Follow the mark, you have %2$s minutes.
vow.tears-of-ink.choose.title: Vow
vow.tears-of-ink.choose.text: The contract is signed, but one clause remains. Beyond the gate everyone walks their own road — and the road decides what you become. Your vow will remain with you forever.
vow.tears-of-ink.ink.name: Path of Ink
vow.tears-of-ink.ink.short: The Fountain's power in your veins.
vow.tears-of-ink.ink.text: The Fountain's Ink will take you in. Black books will open, the Ink Hearts of the fallen will answer your call. But Ink is a foreign power: the more of it in you, the less of you remains.
vow.tears-of-ink.soul.name: Path of Soul
vow.tears-of-ink.soul.short: Your own power, granted by no one.
vow.tears-of-ink.soul.text: You will walk with what is already yours. White books will open, and your Soul will awaken through your deeds. Ink Hearts will stay silent: one who chose the light cannot hear their call.
vow.tears-of-ink.book_blurred: The lines blur. This path is not for you.
vow.tears-of-ink.skill_asleep: "%s" sleeps: it belongs to another path.
vow.tears-of-ink.book_other: The lines blur. This path is not for you.
vow.tears-of-ink.awakening.contract_0: First easy contract fulfilled. Your Soul awakens: +%s.
vow.tears-of-ink.awakening.contract_1: First medium contract fulfilled. Your Soul awakens: +%s.
vow.tears-of-ink.awakening.contract_2: First hard contract fulfilled. Your Soul awakens: +%s.
vow.tears-of-ink.awakening.diary: You know this world well enough not to fear it. Soul: +%s.
vow.tears-of-ink.awakening.tempering: The shields held — and so did you. Soul: +%s.
vow.tears-of-ink.awakening.mercy: Others' wounds closed under your light. Soul: +%s.
guide.tears-of-ink.vow.chosen.ink: The Path of Ink. Bold. The Fountain will welcome you — while you still have something to give.
guide.tears-of-ink.vow.chosen.soul: The Path of Soul. A rare choice in these parts. Guard your light — it can be seen from afar.
guide.tears-of-ink.vow.gate: Not so fast. The gate will not let through one who has taken no vow.
trader.tears-of-ink.exchange.text: The Fountain loves balance. Give me some of the Ink in you — and your Soul will unfold in the space left behind.
trader.tears-of-ink.exchange.no_sold: You have already sold part of your soul. Return it first — through Atonement.
trader.tears-of-ink.exchange.no_limit: There is nothing more I can take. Your Soul will find the rest on its own.
trader.tears-of-ink.exchange.no_ink: There is too little Ink in you — I will not take the last of it.
trader.tears-of-ink.exchanged: The Ink leaves, the Soul unfolds. Soul: %s, Ink reserve: %s.
trader.tears-of-ink.unexchanged: You give back what you traded for. Not all of it returns. Soul: %s, Ink reserve: %s.
trader.tears-of-ink.sell.unexchange: Your Soul is higher than you were born with — that is my work. I will take the exchange back, but return less Ink.
item.tears-of-ink.skill_book_ink_jump.de: Ink pushes off the void itself.
item.tears-of-ink.skill_book_stride.desc: A step that cannot be stopped.
A heavy step forward: shields stay raised, enemies are pushed aside.
item.tears-of-ink.skill_book_ascension.d: The spirit is lighter than the body.
Shift + jump from the ground — your spirit lifts you high. The fall won't hurt.
vow.tears-of-ink.heart.contract_0: First easy contract fulfilled. A small Ink Heart answers: Ink reserve +%s.
vow.tears-of-ink.heart.contract_1: First medium contract fulfilled. Small Ink Heart: Ink reserve +%s.
vow.tears-of-ink.heart.contract_2: First hard contract fulfilled. Small Ink Heart: Ink reserve +%s.
vow.tears-of-ink.heart.miniboss: The guardian's Ink Heart answers your call. Ink reserve +%s — and there is less of you.
item.tears-of-ink.worn_ram_shield.desc1: A pilgrim's shield. It has seen better days.
item.tears-of-ink.worn_ram_shield.desc2: Restore at a crafting table: shield + 1 Pale Ingot.
item.tears-of-ink.worn_mercy_shield.desc: A pilgrim's shield. Light still smoulders in it.
Restore at a crafting table: shield + 1 Pale Ingot.
item.tears-of-ink.dim_scimitar.desc1: The Ink in the blade barely breathes.
item.tears-of-ink.dim_scimitar.desc2: Wave (R): weaker and costlier than a true scimitar's.
item.tears-of-ink.dim_scimitar.desc3: Restore at a crafting table: blade + 1 Pale Ingot.
guide.tears-of-ink.vow.ask: Before I hand you what is due — tell me which road you will take.
item.tears-of-ink.pale_linear_greatsword: Pale Forest · heavy two-handed sword. Wide swings and a finishing thrust.
item.tears-of-ink.blood_katar.desc1: Bloodwood · light thrusting blade. Fast thrusts with a chance to cause bleeding.
item.tears-of-ink.blood_pata.desc1: Bloodwood · medium arm-mounted blade. Thrusts and sweeping cuts.
item.tears-of-ink.blood_curved_greatswor: Bloodwood · heavy two-handed sword. Circular strikes that can cause bleeding.
item.tears-of-ink.ink_seax.desc1: Inkwood · light blade. Quick slashes that slow the target.
item.tears-of-ink.ink_falchion.desc1: Inkwood · medium blade. Fast cutting strikes and slowing effects.
item.tears-of-ink.ink_kriegsmesser.desc1: Inkwood · heavy two-handed sword. Thrusts and powerful sweeping strikes.
item.tears-of-ink.pale_misericorde.desc1: Pale Forest · a light piercing blade. A fast series of narrow thrusts.
item.tears-of-ink.pale_longsword.desc1: Pale Forest · ordinary weapon. A straight hand-and-a-half blade.
item.tears-of-ink.pale_sword.desc1: Spire · common, one-handed. Light and fast.
item.tears-of-ink.pale_greatsword.desc1: Spire · common, two-handed. Faster than other heavies.
item.tears-of-ink.blood_sword.desc1: Blood · common, one-handed. Sometimes draws blood.
item.tears-of-ink.blood_greatsword.desc1: Blood · common, two-handed. Sometimes draws blood.
item.tears-of-ink.ink_sword.desc1: Ink · common, one-handed. Hits slow the foe.
item.tears-of-ink.ink_greatsword.desc1: Ink · common, two-handed. Hits slow the foe.
gear.tears-of-ink.dull: %s is dulling — sharpen it with Pigment at an Ink Anvil.
gear.tears-of-ink.degraded: %s went dull and fell to %s. That tier's properties sleep.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.pale_ore: Found underground in the Pale Forest (Y 0–72). A stone pickaxe is enough. Drops Raw Pale Metal.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.raw_pale_metal: From Pale Ore and pale Spire soldiers. Smelt into a Pale Ingot.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.blood_ore: Found shallow under Bloodwood valleys (Y 10–60). Needs an iron pickaxe. Drops Raw Blood Metal.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.raw_blood_metal: From Blood Ore. Smelt into a Blood Ingot.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.raw_ink_metal: No ore: sometimes dropped by foes slain in the Inkwood, and found in deep ruin chests. Smelt into an Ink Ingot.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.ink_anvil: Forge local weapons, shields and armor in a 3×3 grid. Make the anvil at a crafting table from 5 Pale Ingots, 3 Asphoda and 1 Ink. Sharpen Contrast and Rubric weapons with Pigment, one per slot (a quarter of the edge each).
jei.tears-of-ink.info.pigment: The main forging currency: sharpening, ink weapons, tier ascension, changing vows. The Soul Trader pays it for Fulfilled Contracts.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.asphoda: Mined from asphodelite underground and found in ruin chests. Used for the Ink Anvil, other stations and equipment.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.blood_clot: From blood caterpillars and the Blood Collector tank. Blood weapon material.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.ink: From ink caterpillars. Spire weapon and Ink Anvil material.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.fulfilled_contract: Reward for a Hunt contract. The Soul Trader pays Pigment for it and may give the hunter's weapon.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.cursed_altar: Weapon awakenings. Place a weapon and a reagent (blood clots — Blood property, ink — Ink property), pick a slot, press Awaken. The result only sticks after Keep; Again rerolls, each costlier. A Blood Crystal or Ink Echo raises a property of its line by one level (III only this way). Slots for all weapons: Dim 1, Contrast 2, Rubric 3. Absorption can only roll and work on ordinary weapons. Foreign line works at 60%.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.madness_shard: From Ink hunters: 1–2 per contract with an Ink hunter, 2–3 for slaying one yourself. Used for the Cursed Altar.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.ink_echo: Rarely dropped by foes slain in the Inkwood. Raises an ink property by one level at the Cursed Altar.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.blood_crystal: A rare reward from Harvest and special contracts. Raises a blood property by one level at the Cursed Altar.
font.tears-of-ink.incomplete: The Font is incomplete: %s missing — places highlighted.
font.tears-of-ink.sigil: The Spire acknowledges your valor: Sigil of Valor.
font.tears-of-ink.sigil_progress: Points toward a Sigil of Valor: %s of %s.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.valor_sigil:
Spire — from Hunt contracts: medium 1 point, hard 2; a Sigil per 8 points. Ascends Spire weapons in the Font.

Ascension Font — a build with a 5×5 base, 4 layers: blood wood at the bottom; on it, 3×3 water in the centre, a pale ring around the water (planks, stairs, slabs — any pale wood); blood wood pillars 2 high at the ring corners. Stair facing and decorations don't matter. Stand in the centre of the water: the Font awakens (black water — Path of Ink, white — Path of Soul). Shift+Use with a weapon raises its tier: Dim → Contrast costs 8 Pigment and 1 line resource, Contrast → Rubric 16 and 2. If incomplete, it highlights what's missing.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.crimson_flower:
Blood — reward of the Crimson Harvest (Arena, later); for now — 25% from a medium or hard contract with a Blood hunter. Ascends Blood weapons in the Font.

Shift+Use with a weapon raises its tier: Dim → Contrast costs 8 Pigment and 1 line resource, Contrast → Rubric 16 and 2. If incomplete, it highlights what's missing.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.hope_mote:
Ink — from the Soul Trader's special orders (later). Ascends Ink weapons in the Font.

Shift+Use with a weapon raises its tier: Dim → Contrast costs 8 Pigment and 1 line resource, Contrast → Rubric 16 and 2. If incomplete, it highlights what's missing.

diary.tears-of-ink.entry.ink_anvil.title: [[ink_anvil|Ink Anvil]]
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.ink_anvil.text:
Place the [[ink_anvil|Ink Anvil]] and open it with right-click. Its 3×3 grid forges local blades, shields, armor and ranged weapons. A regular crafting table cannot make them. Try forging a [[pale_sword|Pale Sword]].
Contrast and Rubric weapons can also be sharpened here. Place a blade and Pigment in separate slots, one per slot. Each Pigment restores a quarter of the edge. Even things grow weary, much like people.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.cursed_altar.te:
The [[cursed_altar|Cursed Altar]] is made at a crafting table. Shards of Madness come from Ink Hunters, and blood from Blood Collectors. Look for Asphoda underground and in ruin chests.
Place a weapon on the altar: Dim has one awakening slot, Contrast two, Rubric three. Clots grant Blood properties and Ink grants Ink properties. Remember to keep the chosen property. Rerolls cost more. A Blood Crystal or Ink Echo strengthens a property of its affinity. Absorption works only on ordinary weapons.
item.tears-of-ink.ram_shield.desc2: Ram: charge forward and knock enemies back.

diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_fog.title: Fog and Flame
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_fog.text: The fog here hides even nearby paths. A hand lantern helps you see the road: it parts the mist more effectively in your off-hand than on your hotbar. An [[ink_lantern|Ink Lantern]] or a [[stone_lantern|Stone Lantern]] creates pockets of clearer air. But do not mistake visibility for safety. I think I made that mistake once… A lantern you place yourself begins unlit. Right-click to light it for 10 Ink; no more than four player-made lanterns may burn nearby at once. Shift-right-click your own lit lantern to extinguish it.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_soul.text:
You chose Soul. Hold a Soul shield in each hand. Restore worn shields at an ordinary crafting table: one Pale Ingot and a [[restore_ram_shield|worn Ram Shield]] or [[restore_mercy_shield|worn Shield of Mercy]]. No Pigment is needed.
Left-click in Bastion to strike with the right, left, then both shields. When a fully prepared strike misses, a luminous phantom travels up to five blocks, striking foes along its path. Walls stop it.
Hold right-click to defend. A perfect block preserves Soul; an ordinary one spends it. Release to return accumulated force. R with two shields triggers Resonance; Shift + R uses the left shield's ability. Changing the pair loses accumulated force. Ram and Repel serve offense, Radiant defense, and Mercy healing. Endurance is not stillness.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_ink.title: Vow of Ink: Borrowed Power
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_ink.text:
You chose Ink. It replenishes slowly on its own, while dashes and abilities draw from your reserves. Successful swings with ordinary weapons restore a little Ink; hits from hunter weapons do not. Watch how much power remains before charging into a fight. I will not tell you that borrowed strength must be your ruin. But remember that it is borrowed.
Restore your starter [[restore_dim_scimitar|Dim Scimitar]] at a regular crafting table with one Pale Ingot to obtain the full Wave Sword.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_ruins.tex: Roads, temples, fallen walls… Someone built all this long before you arrived. Chests sometimes remain in ruins, and Ink Fountains can be found in temples. Do not pass them by, but do not take silence for an invitation. I know this masonry. I should know it. Why can I not remember whose it was?
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_memory.te: The pale soldier has fallen, yet I can still picture his formation. I recognize that discipline — or am I merely convincing myself that I do? Words, names, faces slip away whenever I try to hold on to them. Only a strange certainty remains: these soldiers were once more than shells beneath armor. Forgive me. I cannot tell you more just yet.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_region_pa:
Pale trees cover the outer lands. Roads, temples and ruins lie among them. The Spire's soldiers still serve along roads, at gates, by campfires and on watchtowers. Lighting the lanterns at camps and gates grants a respite from new garrisons. Their chests do not refill.
The motionless Crimson Sun promises no safety: monsters still lurk in shadows and underground. Food from your world provides 30% less nutrition and saturation here.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_region_bl: Scarlet foliage hides lowlands where Crimson Heralds rise. Houses enclosed by walls stand near their roots, with crosses at the centers of settlements. Lanterns burn here; you can find Bloodwood caterpillars, fleshberries and Blood Collectors. Chests may contain local metal and Blood Clots. Do not judge these places by the color of their leaves alone: silence does not always foretell disaster.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_region_in: The nearer you draw to the heart of the Lands, the more concentrated the Ink becomes. Here you may find Ink metal and caterpillars carrying Pigment. Bring light and proper equipment before venturing deeper. I cannot remember everything that hides in the fog.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_region_la: The waters of these lands are dark, as though soot had dissolved in them. Reeds grow along the shore. Remember the landmarks on dry land before crossing the water: it is easy to lose your bearings in the mist. For now I recall nothing of what lies farther on.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_region_ed: Here is the edge. Trees and roads fall behind you; ahead lie barren ground and a wall of fog. Do not mistake this mist for a path to another land: the Ink Lands end here. If you lose your way, remember your mirror and the last fountain you opened.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_adit.text: In the Pale Forest wooden landmarks may point toward an old mine entrance. Stone stairs lead deep underground, past lanterns and landings, ending at closed platforms. They grant access to deeper rock, but promise no safe road beyond. Remember your last fountain before descending.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_asphoda.t: Asphoda lies within veins of asphodelite. Mine the ore with a suitable pickaxe or find Asphoda in ruin chests. You will need it for the [[ink_anvil|Ink Anvil]] and other stations. Familiar ores can also be found in asphodelite rock. Do not confuse Asphoda with Pale Metal; they serve different purposes.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_blood_met: Blood ore is found in the Bloodwood. Raw Blood Metal may also be found in settlement chests there, and rarely in Pale Forest ruins. Smelt it and use the ingots at the [[ink_anvil|Ink Anvil]]. Not everything with a crimson gleam carries the Herald's power: distinguish ordinary equipment from special hunter weapons.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_ink_metal: In the Inkwood, Ink Metal comes from defeated enemies rather than ore veins. Look for raw metal in the chests of the Inkwood itself as well. Rare spoils include an Ink Echo for strengthening awakenings. Smelt the metal and use its ingots at the [[ink_anvil|Ink Anvil]].
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_armor.tex:
Local armor is forged at the [[ink_anvil|Ink Anvil]]. Its name indicates weight, region and slot. Light armor requires silk thread and quickens your stride; medium uses more metal without a speed change; heavy requires Asphoda, protects better and slows you. Mix pieces freely.
For example: [[pale_headband|Light Pale Helmet]], [[pale_chain_hood|Medium Pale Helmet]], [[pale_closed_helmet|Heavy Pale Helmet]]. Foreign armor loses 60% of its armor and toughness here. Start with one local piece.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_alchemy.t:
Make an [[alchemy_table|Alchemy Table]] and an [[empty_flask|Empty Flask]] at a regular crafting table.
The table has three ingredient slots and one for a flask. [[tearbloom_brew|Tearbloom Brew]] and [[strong_tearbloom_brew|Strong Tearbloom Brew]] temporarily ease the effects of selling Soul, but do not restore what was lost.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_fountain_: Touch a fountain with an empty hand to open it for yourself. With the mirror in your main hand, right-click an opened fountain without crouching to see known bowls. Away from a fountain, hold Shift and right-click with the mirror to return to the last bowl activated by hand. Preparation takes 2.5 seconds, followed by a 30-second cooldown. Travel is free, but combat, damage and active Hunts or orders may prevent it. Some temples stand beside roads; others are hidden in the woods. After meeting the Trader at your second fountain, Shift-right-click any personally opened bowl to call her.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_soul_barg: The Trader offers Ink in exchange for a fragment of your maximum Soul. The price is not just a number in your veins: food and healing grow less effective. A follower of Soul may lose a reached rank and its benefits. Your vow does not change, and past deeds remain remembered. Read the terms carefully before confirming: the Trader does not sell Soul back to you.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_hunt_fiel: On the Trail of a Hunt

Ask the Soul Trader for a Hunt contract and travel to the marked place. A Hunter and their prey await you there. Choose a difficulty you can handle. To earn a Fulfilled Contract, contribute enough to defeating the prey; simply watching the fight is not enough.
Return to the Trader for Pigment. Medium contracts give one Valor point, hard contracts give two; every eight points grant a Sigil of Valor. Fountain travel is restricted while a contract is active.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_hunter_sp: Spire hunters keep their distance: a few strikes, a retreat, then another technique. They can dash away and force the fight anew. Strength and equipment vary with their rank. Watch their blades and do not mistake retreat for weakness.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_hunter_bl: Blood hunters favor pressure. They combine strikes with techniques of Blood weapons, using dashes to catch prey or evade attacks. Do not interfere without cause: the appearance of a warrior's weapon alone does not reveal his intentions.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_hunter_in: An Ink hunter presses forward with little respite. He uses his techniques frequently and rushes forward rather than retreating. Even victory over prey may not calm him: after a Hunt he may turn his weapons against you. Keep an escape route in mind.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_mad_order: Sometimes the Trader sends you after a maddened hunter rather than a beast. This marked foe is hostile and strong, and may be a veteran or legendary warrior. Your time is limited. Such hunters yield Essences of Soul: trade three to the Trader for one Mote of Soul.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_harvest.t: The Crimson Herald grants peace beneath the bloody trees, but even a god dreams nightmares. At the Arena of the Brave, the Keeper gathers those willing to fight them. Speak to the Keeper, choose difficulty and party size, then join the gathering. Participants fight monsters together; hunters may fill empty places. Those who contribute to victory can claim a Gift from the Keeper and open it with a right-click. The Harvest is a separate trial, not a required road to the Spire.
Sometimes a pale bird passes above the Pale Forest. Listen for its hoot: in the fog it may reveal the bird before its wings come into view. Owls mostly rest among the branches and dive at local caterpillars. Small families sometimes gather. The bird is peaceful toward travelers; you need not kill it to learn about it.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_pale_stri: Tall, armless figures sometimes emerge from the mist of the Pale Forest. They wander alone or together, doing travelers no harm. At times they stop near temples or amid the trees, and their singing carries far into the distance. It is no howl, but rather a sorrowful prayer for what was lost, in which hope still lingers. Listening to their choir, I cannot help but wonder: is it one voice speaking through so many forms? Perhaps they are echoes of human suffering and hope — a single being that has never been able to find rest.
mixer.tears-of-ink.title: Tears of Ink mixer
mixer.tears-of-ink.preview_tip: Near-source preview; combat volume depends on distance
mixer.tears-of-ink.reset_group_tip: Reset group and all its sounds to 100%
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_blood_col: Blood Collectors stand beneath scarlet foliage. A pump slowly fills the tank, where blood thickens. Right-click the tank with an empty hand to collect its Blood Clots. These serve to awaken weapons at the [[cursed_altar|Cursed Altar]]. Do not be surprised by caterpillars near these contraptions: they too seek food.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_soul_deed: Soul grows stronger not simply with the passage of time. Accomplish Deeds: withstand blows with shields, master perfect blocks, defeat enemies with a shield and use fully charged Resonances. Reaching a milestone increases your maximum Soul. At 115 you become Steadfast, at 130 Luminous, at 150 Unbending. Ranks strengthen shield defense and retaliation. If you sell Soul to the Trader, your rank may fall, but the memory of the Deed remains.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_ink_ranks: On the Path of Ink, strength depends on how much Ink your body can hold, not on the number of Soul fragments surrendered. At a maximum of 50 you become Marked: dashing costs less. At 100, Tainted: dashes recover faster and a second jump costs less Ink. At 150, Hollow: truly evading an enemy strike with a dash restores some Ink. Past achievements remain remembered. Take care, traveler.
diary.tears-of-ink.section.empty: There are no entries here yet. Continue your journey.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_pale_deer: Herds of deer still live in the Pale Forest. While some feed on grass and flowers, sentinels rise onto their hind legs and watch the surroundings. At an alarm call, the herd answers and flees in long bounds. Their voices and hoofbeats often reach you before antlers emerge from the fog. Approach carefully and make use of light and a bow: giving chase rarely succeeds. A successful hunt yields plenty of meat and some hide.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_weaponcra:
Local blades are made at the [[ink_anvil|Ink Anvil]]. Restore your starter [[restore_dim_scimitar|Dim Scimitar]] with one Pale Ingot at a crafting table to obtain the Wave Sword. For a new blade, try a [[pale_sword|Pale Sword]]. Forging a new [[ram_shield|Ram Shield]] requires Pigment, but a worn shield can be [[restore_ram_shield|restored]] with one Pale Ingot at a crafting table.
Ordinary blades restore Ink once per successful swing, not for every enemy struck. Blood blades may cause bleeding; Ink blades slow targets. Hunter weapons are earned from contracts or forged with special recipes; they do not restore Ink on hits. Foreign weapons deal 60% less damage here, including against other travelers.

diary.tears-of-ink.fate.weapon.ink.hint: Combine your [[restore_dim_scimitar|Dim Scimitar]] with one Pale Ingot at a regular crafting table to obtain the Wave Sword. If you lost your starter blade, forge another local blade at the [[ink_anvil|Ink Anvil]].
diary.tears-of-ink.fate.weapon.soul.hint: Restore a [[restore_ram_shield|worn Ram Shield]] or [[restore_mercy_shield|Mercy Shield]] with one Pale Ingot at a regular crafting table. Alternatively, obtain a local blade or a full shield.

message.tears-of-ink.jaber.outside: Jaber cannot travel beyond the fog wall. Choose coordinates inside the Ink Lands.
message.tears-of-ink.jaber.ready: Jaber is ready! Enter /jaber X Z.
